name: DR Congo (east)
value: Kivu clashes; no city changed hands
summary: MONUSCO chief meets Kabila-led coalition in Goma; fighting continues without major gains
state: The head of MONUSCO met leaders of the Kabila-led FRN coalition, which includes the M23, in Goma, allAfrica reported on 4 Nov. Former president Kabila joined the rebel coalition in October (Al Jazeera). Clashes continue in the Kivus but no major city has changed hands, and talks under the August roadmap remain stalled as of 5 Nov.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for eastern DR Congo.
